A seen key is never made unseen by counter exhaustion; its first descriptor/order is retained. Exhausted counts cannot wrap and the Lua driver refuses saturated capture before derived/result. closed_groups.facts: New host.output_create_new uses std OpenOptions write+create_new and returns a Lua userdata or nil/error. Both JSON output and sidecar are created separately/exclusively before boot; aliases/existing unreadable files are refused by OS creation semantics, not path spelling/read-probe heuristics.
